name: Pohang University of Science and Technology
summary: Pohang science and engineering university; international freshmen take a 100% English-taught curriculum and enter without a declared major.

ib.text: No minimum IB score is published. If your school follows the IB, IB score reporting is mandatory; an English test or an English medium-of-instruction letter is needed. Fall 2027 guideline is due in January 2027.

apply.via: Study in Korea online application, with documents by post

programmes.name: Undergraduate School (undeclared major)
programmes.about: International admits enter the Mueunjae School of Undergraduate Studies, then move into a department: mathematics, physics, chemistry, life sciences, or an engineering department such as materials, mechanical, electrical, computer science or chemical.
programmes.selectionNote: Document review (transcripts, personal statement, recommendation, English proof); no interview is required. 2027 Spring documents shown; Fall 2027 guideline not yet published.

notes: From 2027 international admission runs twice a year: the table shows applications in March, results in June and the year starting at the end of August, with no days given yet.
All admitted students are granted a full tuition waiver from their first semester, and the curriculum for international students is taught entirely in English with Korean language courses.
The international track is for applicants who are not Korean citizens, with proof of nationality needed for both parents; a Korean-origin parent or dual nationality brings extra documents.
